'''Hawk Carrow''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Carrow often accompanied [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] as a [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilot]] aboard the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Dorion Discus]]''. During one mission, the ''Dorion Discus'' crashed on [[New Bakstre]] and Carrow was captured by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. Garnet rescued Carrow from the [[M-Class Imperial Attack Transport]] ''[[Regina Cayli]]''.

==Biography==
[[File:RoarkGarnet.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Roark Garnet rescued Hawk from the ''Regina Cayli'']]
Hawk Carrow operated as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], occasionally working as a co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] aboard his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Dorion Discus]]''. While making an unscheduled delivery to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Bakstre]], the ''Dorion Discus'' was forced down by [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]]. Carrow's leg was wounded by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[M-Class Imperial Attack Transport]] ''[[Regina Cayli]]'', and he was captured. In the ship's [[Medical bay/Legends|infirmary]], a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] applied a [[healing sheath]] to Carrow's leg. Garnet, who had evaded capture by the Empire, infiltrated the ''Regina Cayli'' and rescued Carrow.<ref name="Regina" />

Sometime later, Carrow and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Nagraoao]] were captured by the Empire and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] in the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]]. Roark Garnet took the ''Dorion Discus'' to the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]] to rescue his friends, but was stopped for inspection by a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. Garnet bribed the [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Kessel system)|Navy officer]] to let him go.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
